_meta._description: Milestone tracking schema fragment. Adds milestoneRecord schema for tracking business-friendly progress points on a case. Per ADR-001 a thin app-specific layer over the existing statusRecord.

milestoneRecord.title: Milestone Record
milestoneRecord.description: A business-friendly progress point on a case. Each milestoneRecord captures the moment a case crosses a defined milestone (e.g. 'intake compleet', 'beschikking verzonden'). Drives the CaseMilestonesWidget and CaseProgress widgets without coupling to the underlying statusType graph.

milestoneIdentifier.description: Stable identifier for the milestone (matches caseType.milestones[].identifier)
milestoneIdentifier.title: Milestone

reached.description: Whether the milestone is currently reached. Reversal sets this to false.

reachedAt.description: Timestamp the milestone was reached (null until reached === true)

triggerSource.description: What caused the milestone to fire

triggeredBy.description: Nextcloud user UID of the actor (or the system identifier for workflow/status sources)

reversalReason.description: Why the milestone was reversed (nullable; required when reversedAt is set)
